verdict.rationale: PagerDuty clearly ships automations, including Incident Workflows, Event Orchestration and AI-generated orchestration rules, so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows version history, change review/approval, or rollback for those automations. The REST API versioning header concerns API versions, and Post-Incident Reviews concern incidents, not automation changes, so neither counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
